title: Windows ASR Rules
description: Microsoft Defender Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rule GUIDs and descriptions.

entries.comment: Helps prevent exploitation of known vulnerable signed drivers, reducing the risk of kernel-level malware.

metadata.asrRule: Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers

entries.comment: Limits Adobe Reader's ability to spawn child processes, mitigating potential attack vectors via PDF files.

metadata.asrRule: Block Adobe Reader from creating child processes

entries.comment: Prevents Office applications from creating child processes, reducing the risk of macro-based attacks.

metadata.asrRule: Block all Office applications from creating child processes

entries.comment: Protects against credential dumping attacks by blocking access to LSASS.

metadata.asrRule: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem (lsass.exe)

entries.comment: Prevents execution of malicious code delivered via email clients or webmail, enhancing email security.

metadata.asrRule: Block executable content from email client and webmail

entries.comment: Ensures only trusted and commonly used executable files are allowed to run, reducing the risk of running malicious software.

metadata.asrRule: Block executable files from running unless they meet a prevalence, age, or trusted list criterion

entries.comment: Prevents execution of scripts that are obfuscated, mitigating script-based malware attacks.

metadata.asrRule: Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts

entries.comment: Blocks script engines from executing potentially malicious downloaded content.

metadata.asrRule: Block JavaScript or VBScript from launching downloaded executable content

entries.comment: Reduces the risk of Office macros and exploits creating malicious executable files.

metadata.asrRule: Block Office applications from creating executable content

entries.comment: Prevents Office applications from injecting code into other processes, mitigating exploit techniques.

metadata.asrRule: Block Office applications from injecting code into other processes

entries.comment: Prevents communication apps like Outlook from creating child processes, reducing the risk of phishing and email-based attacks.

metadata.asrRule: Block Office communication application from creating child processes

entries.comment: Mitigates persistence mechanisms by blocking malicious WMI event subscriptions.

metadata.asrRule: Block persistence through WMI event subscription

entries.comment: Prevents lateral movement and remote execution attacks using PSExec and WMI.

metadata.asrRule: Block process creations originating from PSExec and WMI commands

entries.comment: Prevents attackers from rebooting machines into Safe Mode to disable security tools.

metadata.asrRule: Block rebooting machine in Safe Mode (preview)

entries.comment: Prevents execution of potentially malicious files from USB devices, enhancing removable media security.

metadata.asrRule: Block untrusted and unsigned processes that run from USB

entries.comment: Mitigates attacks using copied or impersonated legitimate system tools.

metadata.asrRule: Block use of copied or impersonated system tools (preview)

entries.comment: Prevents the creation of webshells on servers, reducing the risk of web-based attacks and persistence.
Mitigates macro-based attacks by blocking dangerous API calls from Office macros.

metadata.asrRule: Block Win32 API calls from Office macros

entries.comment: Enhances ransomware protection by leveraging advanced detection and mitigation techniques.
